BusinessContext.Description: Migration from SWIFT MT202 (Financial Institution Credit Transfer) to ISO 20022 pacs.009.001.08 (FinancialInstitutionCreditTransfer). MT202 is used for bank-to-bank transfers, cover payments, and interbank settlements. pacs.009 is its ISO 20022 equivalent with enhanced structured data.

Variable.name: MAX_MSG_ID_LENGTH
Variable.description: Maximum length of pacs.009 MsgId field

Variable.name: AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS
Variable.description: Regulatory minimum audit log retention period

Variable.name: BIC_CACHE_TTL_HOURS
Variable.description: BIC directory cache time-to-live in hours

Variable.name: SANCTIONS_SCREENING_ENABLED
Variable.description: Whether real-time sanctions screening is active

Field.Description: Unique reference assigned by the sender to identify the message
Reference of the related message (e.g. MT103 reference for cover payments)
Financial institution ordering the transfer (sender bank)
Intermediary bank between ordering and beneficiary institutions
Bank where the beneficiary institution holds its account
Financial institution that is the final beneficiary of the transfer
Additional information for the receiver bank (e.g. cover payment reference)
Unique identification of the pacs.009 message
Date and time at which the message was created
Unique identification assigned by ordering institution
BIC of the ordering institution (MT202 field 52A)
BIC of the intermediary institution (MT202 field 56A)
BIC of account with institution (MT202 field 57A)
BIC of the beneficiary institution (MT202 field 58A)

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: related_reference = source.field_21 message_id = related_reference return message_id

General.ImpactIfFails: Message rejected - cannot process without unique identifier
General.BusinessRationale: Related reference from MT202 field 21 becomes the pacs.009 message ID for traceability
General.AuditRequirement: Message ID logged for cross-message audit trail. Retained AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Unique reference required per SWIFT ISO 15022 MT202 standards. Enables linkage between cover payment and underlying MT103.
General.DataPrivacy: Reference is operational identifier. No PII. No GDPR special handling required.
General.MigrationNote: MT202 field 21 (Related Reference) maps to GrpHdr.MsgId in pacs.009 for cover payment traceability.
General.CachingStrategy: No caching - direct copy from source field.

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: transaction_reference = source.field_20 end_to_end_id = transaction_reference return end_to_end_id

General.ImpactIfFails: Payment tracking impossible without end-to-end reference
General.BusinessRationale: MT202 field 20 is the transaction reference that maps to EndToEndId for payment tracking
General.PerformanceImpact: NEGLIGIBLE (direct string copy with format validation)
General.AuditRequirement: Transaction reference logged for audit trail. Required for EMIR and MiFID II reporting.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Unique reference required per SWIFT ISO 15022 MT202 standards.
General.DataPrivacy: Transaction reference is operational identifier. No direct PII.
General.MigrationNote: Clean 1:1 copy from MT202 field 20 to pacs.009 EndToEndId.

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: related_ref = source.field_21 transaction_id = related_ref return transaction_id

General.ImpactIfFails: Cover payment linkage to MT103 lost
General.BusinessRationale: Field 21 links MT202 cover payment to original MT103 customer transfer
General.AuditRequirement: Related reference stored for cross-message audit trail.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Required for correspondent banking audit trail and reconciliation.
General.DataPrivacy: Reference is operational data. No PII.
General.MigrationNote: MT202 field 21 maps to TxId to preserve the link between cover payment and underlying transaction.

MappingFormula.Expression: currency = extract_currency(source.field_32A) amount = extract_amount(source.field_32A) target.InstdAmt = create_xml_amount(amount, currency)
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: field_32a = source.field_32A date_str = substring(field_32a, 1, 6) currency_code = substring(field_32a, 7, 3) amount_string = substring(field_32a, 10) amount_normalized = replace(amount_string, ",", ".") amount_decimal = parse_decimal(amount_normalized) xml_amount = { value: amount_decimal, currency: currency_code } return xml_amount

Condition.ElseAction: REJECT with error "Invalid currency code in field 32A"

General.ImpactIfFails: Interbank settlement fails - incorrect amount causes financial loss
General.BusinessRationale: Core financial value of the interbank transfer
General.AuditRequirement: Amount logged with original SWIFT format and converted ISO 20022 format.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Accurate amount required for settlement finality and regulatory reporting.
General.MigrationNote: SWIFT uses comma decimal separator (500000,). ISO 20022 uses dot (500000.00). Conversion mandatory.
General.CachingStrategy: No caching - direct extraction from source field.

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: field_32a = source.field_32A date_str = substring(field_32a, 1, 6) year = "20" + substring(date_str, 1, 2) month = substring(date_str, 3, 2) day = substring(date_str, 5, 2) iso_date = year + "-" + month + "-" + day return iso_date

General.ImpactIfFails: Settlement date incorrect causing value dating errors
General.BusinessRationale: Value date from field 32A determines when funds are settled between institutions
General.AuditRequirement: Value date logged for settlement reconciliation.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Correct value date required for same-day settlement systems (RTGS).
General.DataPrivacy: Date is operational data. No PII.
General.MigrationNote: SWIFT date format YYMMDD converts to ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format.

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: field_52a = source.field_52A bic = extract_bic_from_field(field_52a) instructing_agent_bic = validate_bic(bic) return instructing_agent_bic

Condition.ElseAction: USE sender BIC from message header
REJECT with error "Invalid BIC in field 52A"

General.ImpactIfFails: Cannot identify ordering institution for settlement
General.BusinessRationale: Identifies the bank initiating the interbank transfer — required for settlement chain
General.AuditRequirement: Ordering institution BIC logged for correspondent banking audit trail.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Institution-level sanctions screening required per OFAC and EU regulations.
General.DataPrivacy: BIC codes are public identifiers. No GDPR restrictions.
General.MigrationNote: MT202 field 52A (Ordering Institution) maps directly to pacs.009 InstgAgt (Instructing Agent).
General.CachingStrategy: BIC directory cached BIC_CACHE_TTL_HOURS hours for fast validation.

MappingFormula.Expression: IF source.field_56A != null THEN target.IntrmyAgt1.BICFI = extract_bic(source.field_56A) ENDIF
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: field_56a = source.field_56A if (field_56a is not null) then intermediary_bic = extract_bic_from_field(field_56a) return validate_bic(intermediary_bic) else return null endif

General.ImpactIfFails: Intermediary routing chain broken — payment may take longer path
General.BusinessRationale: Identifies intermediary bank in the correspondent banking chain
General.AuditRequirement: Intermediary BIC logged for full payment chain traceability.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Sanctions screening of intermediary institution required.
General.DataPrivacy: BIC is public identifier. No GDPR restrictions.
General.MigrationNote: MT202 field 56A (Intermediary Institution) maps to pacs.009 IntrmyAgt1.

MappingFormula.Expression: IF source.field_57A != null THEN target.CdtrAgt.BICFI = extract_bic(source.field_57A) ENDIF
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: field_57a = source.field_57A if (field_57a is not null) then creditor_agent_bic = extract_bic_from_field(field_57a) return validate_bic(creditor_agent_bic) else return null endif

General.ImpactIfFails: Payment may not reach beneficiary institution correctly
General.BusinessRationale: Identifies the bank where beneficiary institution holds account
General.AuditRequirement: Account with institution BIC logged for payment chain audit.
General.ComplianceRequirement: BIC must be reachable via SWIFT network.
General.DataPrivacy: BIC is public identifier. No GDPR restrictions.
General.MigrationNote: MT202 field 57A (Account With Institution) maps to pacs.009 CdtrAgt (Creditor Agent).

Condition.ElseAction: REJECT with error "Missing mandatory field 58A - beneficiary institution required"
REJECT with error "Invalid BIC in field 58A"
BLOCK message AND ALERT compliance team

General.ImpactIfFails: Payment cannot reach beneficiary institution — funds stuck in transit
General.BusinessRationale: Final destination of the interbank transfer — the beneficiary financial institution
General.PerformanceImpact: LOW (BIC validation from cache + sanctions check)
General.AuditRequirement: Beneficiary institution BIC stored for end-to-end payment traceability.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Mandatory sanctions screening of beneficiary institution per OFAC and EU regulations.
General.DataPrivacy: BIC is public identifier. No GDPR restrictions.
General.MigrationNote: MT202 field 58A (Beneficiary Institution) maps directly to pacs.009 Cdtr.FinInstnId.BICFI.
General.CachingStrategy: BIC directory cached. Sanctions screening not cached.

MappingFormula.Expression: IF source.field_72 != null THEN target.InstrForCdtrAgt.InstrInf = normalize(source.field_72) ENDIF
MappingFormula.PseudoCode: field_72 = source.field_72 if (field_72 is not null) then lines = split_by_newline(field_72) instruction_text = join(lines, " ") instruction_text = trim(normalize_whitespace(instruction_text)) return instruction_text else return null endif

General.ImpactIfFails: Cover payment reference lost — manual reconciliation needed
General.BusinessRationale: Sender to receiver information carries cover payment reference and additional routing instructions
General.AuditRequirement: Instruction information logged with transaction for reconciliation.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Cover payment reference must be preserved for correspondent banking audit trail.
General.DataPrivacy: May contain payment references. No direct PII typically.
General.MigrationNote: MT202 field 72 (Sender to Receiver Information) maps to pacs.009 InstrForCdtrAgt.InstrInf. /BNF/ prefix used for beneficiary information, /ACC/ for account information.

Rule.Description: All BIC codes must be valid 8 or 11 character format
Value date in field 32A must be valid YYMMDD format
Generated pacs.009 must validate against XSD schema
All institution BICs must pass sanctions screening
